subject: In which arc does Todo fight Hanami with Playful Cloud?

beats.title: Usage
beats.text: Towards the end of the fight with Hanami, Todo also showcased his ability to switch objects with any desired target, revealing that Boogie Woogie works on anything with enough cursed energy. He switched out Yuji for the special grade cursed tool; Playful Cloud and dealt a devastating blow that crushed Hanami's weak points and pushed the cursed spirit to the edge of defeat.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)

beats.title: Usage / Aoi Todo
beats.text: As a special grade cursed tool, Playful Cloud possesses a considerable amount of cursed energy. This makes it compatible with Aoi Todo's Boogie Woogie, allowing him to switch it out with any desired target. After Megumi left Playful Cloud in the river, Todo was able to summon it to his side by switching it out with Yuji Itadori. With a powerful blow infused with his own cursed energy, Todo was able to smash Hanami's weak points and nearly defeated the cursed spirit.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)

beats.title: Equipment
beats.text:
Cursed Tools
Playful Cloud 遊雲 Yū-un: While it was within his range of his technique, Todo was able to switch out Yuji to summon the special grade cursed tool to his side. By infusing it with his cursed energy, Todo could generate enough destructive force to smash Hanami's extremely hard shell.(Chapter 51, Episode 20) Non-Cursed Tools
Vibraslap ビブラスラップ Biburasurappu: A percussion instrument consisting of a ball connected to a wooden box with metal pieces inside. The player taps the ball to rattle the metal, thereby generating a unique sound. Todo replaced his lost left hand with one, using it in tandem with Boogie Woogie: Revised.(Chapter 260)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess
beats.text:
Immense Durability: Hanami possesses an incredibly hard shell on their body, capable of shattering Kasumi Miwa's sword upon impact.(Chapter 46, Episode 19) They were also effortlessly able to brush off Noritoshi Kamo's Slicing Exorcism attack despite it hitting the side of their head.(Chapter 45, Episode 18) A clean slash to Hanami's leg from Megumi Fushiguro's sword also dealt zero damage.(Chapter 45, Episode 18) Even after being hit directly in their blocking arm by Maki Zenin using the special grade cursed tool, Playful Cloud, they were sent flying away but only suffered minimal damage as a result.(Chapter 47, Episode 19)

After being hit multiple times by Maki and Megumi on their weak points, Hanami was still able to withstands their attacks, recover quickly, and ultimately subdue them with ease. The most the majority of the students could hope to achieve was stall Hanami in time for more backup to arrive. Only Yuji and Todo together were able to injure them enough to make them use their full power. Although Jogo possesses more cursed energy than Hanami and has an elemental advantage over them, he could not have survived Yuji's Black Flash assault followed by a blow from Playful Cloud wielded by Todo like Hanami was able to.(Volume 6)

Enhanced Strength: Hanami has a high degree of physical strength and can easily brutalize a human sorcerer in close range combat. Once Hanami finally closed the distance between them and Noritoshi, it only took a few strikes to incapacitate the sorcerer.(Chapter 46, Episode 19) On the defensive, Hanami was also able hold off Nue as the giant bird-like shikigami divebombed them with its wing.(Chapter 45, Episode 18)

Enhanced Speed: Hanami was fast enough to swiftly escape with Jogo's head after a brief distraction. They were also able to completely blitz past Megumi and Noritoshi, taking them both off guard since Hanami was a great distance away before that moment.(Chapter 45, Episode 18)

Hidden Presence: Gojo has stated that Hanami has the peculiar presence of a regular spirit despite definitely being a curse.(Chapter 53, Episode 21) Additionally, they can move through plants and erase their presence completely, making Hanami difficult to pin down. Hanami is able to move underground using the plants to escape quickly and move through barriers, avoiding exorcism from the aforementioned sorcerer twice. They also took Toge Inumaki, a semi-grade 1 sorcerer, completely by surprise after killing off another curse that the student had just noticed.(Chapter 43, Episode 18)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess
beats.text: Maki used the katana to attack Hanami and although the blade shattered on the first strike, Maki was able to quickly adapt and switch to the three-section staff, Playful Cloud, to fight. Megumi noted that Playful Cloud was difficult for him to use Maki was able to utilize it to fight on par with special grade cursed spirits. She and Megumi swapped weapons a few times against Hanami to take the curse by surprise and were able to do so comfortably.(Chapter 47, Episode 19)

beats.title: Usage / Maki Zenin & Megumi Fushiguro
beats.text:
Playful Cloud's powerful abilities were displayed again when Maki, a girl with little cursed energy but great physical abilities, was able to wield it to contend with a special grade cursed spirit. When their weak points were struck by a blow from Playful Cloud, Hanami was knocked away with great force.

Maki and Megumi Fushiguro were able to trade cursed tools mid-battle to confuse Hanami, leaving them open to an attack from Playful Cloud. Even Megumi, who only possesses average physical strength, was able to harm Hanami using the staff. He did admit, however, that he's uncomfortable wielding a three-section staff. Although she was eventually overpowered, Playful Cloud's equalizing power allowed Maki to contend with Hanami despite her injuries.(Chapter 47, Episode 19)

Playful Cloud later helped Maki better contend with Dagon during the Shibuya Incident.(Chapter 109, Episode 38) In the middle of their battle, Toji appeared and snatched it from her.

beats.title: Synopsis / Enemies Invade the Event
beats.text: The fight continues to rage on as Hanami begins to adapt to Aoi's strategies. At the same time, jujutsu students and teachers alike encounter curse users from Mahito's group. Aoi switches up his approach by swapping Yuji out for Playful Cloud, revealing he can make anything with cursed energy change places. Aoi cracks Hanami's hard shell with Playful Cloud but doesn't quite finish the fight. Before Hanami can activate his Domain Expansion, Juzo's curtain is dispelled and Gojo is revealed to be floating above the battlefield.(Chapter 51, Episode 20)
